A black-and-white clean professional concept art sheet shows three Van'Doei creatures with very different body types. Each is drawn with detailed linework. All share cracked skin and asymmetric anatomy. Each character is clearly labeled with its name. These are the only labels.

The Heat-Watcher left – Skeletal emaciated frame, asymmetrical, massively hypertrophied massive leg and arm. Dark anthracite grey skin with white cracks. Tattered robes, portable brazier on back with smoke. Big tribal mask with paintings. Extremely long hair-tendrils reaching ground like cape. Ritual scars covering exposed skin. Prayer beads in his small hand. Hunched forward reaching toward warmth.

The Cartographer center – Athletic lean build, hypertrophied right arm holding maps. Medium ashen grey skin with fine cracks. Minimal travel gear with metal studs, navigation tools at belt. Simple mask with Concentric patterns. Medium hair-tendrils tied back. Burn-marked gauntlets. Crouched low over ground tracing. Fire-starting kit visible.

The Indebted right – Muscular broad frame, extremely hypertrophied tentacled arm covered in cutting scars. Pale chalky white skin with large cracks. Torn leather apron, spiked collar and bracers. Angular geometric mask covers face completely. Short hair-tendrils barely past shoulders. Standing tall upright. Artisan tools and ash pouch at belt.

The sheet includes mask details, scar patterns, tools focus. They all appear mysterious and imposing. White paper background. Draw inspiration from the given images.

A black-and-white clean professional concept art sheet, inked, shows three Van'Doei creatures with extreme body modifications and cult roles. Each is drawn with detailed linework. All share cracked skin and massively hypertrophied monstrous arms. Each character is clearly labeled with its name. These are the only labels.

The Consoled (left) – Feminine skeletal frame mid-auto-momification, skin mummified and leathery. Pale white-grey skin with geometric crack patterns. Enormously hypertrophied left arm divided in two at the elbow and wrapped in preservation bandages. Wears ceremonial robes with religious symbols. Smooth featureless mask completely covers face. Multiple bracelets.  Standing rigidand lifting his arms to the sky

The Esothropic Child (center) – Small distorted frame with visible mutations from experiments. Dark grey skin with bioluminescent veins. Grotesquely hypertrophied made of many writhing black tendrils like @img7, without any hand. exposed face showing multiple clustered eyes. Wild electric hair-tendrils crackling. Bestial erratic stance weighting on giant closed hand. Wrapped in restraining belts around torso.

The Whisperer (right) – Androgynous lean athletic build. Medium ashen grey with intricate scarification maps. One arm is an armor-likeprosthetics and has a huge blade coming out of its elbow, like @img6 . Wears concealing hooded cloak covered in heretical texts. Mask with speaker grilles for modified vocal communication. Long braided hair-tendrils with hidden scrolls. Alert suspicious posture. 

They all appear unsettling and mysterious. White paper background. Draw inspiration and use the style from the image the image.

A black-and-white clean professional concept art sheet, inked, shows three Van'Doei creatures. Each is drawn with detailed linework. All share cracked skin. Each character is clearly labeled with its name. These are the only labels.

The Kindling left – Their arm is a massive bundle of hundreds of thin root-like tendrils spreading from shoulder, each ending in tiny grasping fingers. Character crouched over brazier, using this arm to sort through ashes. Small young frame. Smooth pale grey skin. A veil is masking their face. Short sprouting hair-tendrils. Right arm normal holding collection pouch.

The Inked center – Their enormous hypertrophied left arm turns into long overflowing mummy bandages. Elderly skeletal figure. Dark grey tattooed skin. Elaborate mask with a long nose covering all face. Long white braided tendril hair. Female looking.

The Rapturous right – Their arm is segmented whip-like appendage coiling around character, covered in sharp metal barbs and blades embedded in flesh, actively wrapping around torso. Extremely muscular scarred build. Medium grey bleeding skin. Big painted european mask. Wild hair. Androgynous.

They all appear mysterious and intense. White paper background. Draw inspiration from the style of the image.
